test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

_______! I forgot to inform you about the party.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Oops**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The aforementioned sentence is an **exclamatory sentence**.
 
• In the given sentence, we notice that the speaker has made a **mistake**.
 
• **Oops **is the sound we use to express the mistake that has been committed.

**Hence, the correct sentence is:**__ *__**Oops**__! I forgot to inform you about the party.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** *

__
 
• These sounds such as Ouch, Oops, Ah, Alas are known as **interjections**.
 
• We use interjections in a sentence to **communicate emotions **like pain, disgust, delight, etc
 
• We use **ouch **for **pain**, **ah **to express **surprise**, **alas **to convey **relief**.
 
 
• Example: ***Ouch**__! I bite my tongue**(pain)***
 
 

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **__Hint__** *

 
• We can recognize an exclamatory statement as well as an interjection with the use of an* ***exclamation mark(!)**
